text.p: U.S. investment house Goldman Sachs said in a research note released on Wednesday it was initiating a number of European telecoms stocks as part of wider high-tech coverage.
"Margins and growth prospects appear most favourable in wireless infrastructure; hence our favoured stocks are Ericsson and Nokia (both rated market outperformers," said the note, dated September 9.

"We would avoid restructuring stories, in part because of the nature of the European markets and in part because of the pace of organic change; we have lower ratings on Siemens (downgraded to market performer), Ascom (market performer) and Alcatel (market underperformer)," Goldman said.
Among smaller-cap stocks, Goldman said it favoured ECI Telecom (market performer). It also saw value in Allgon and Filtronic Comtek (both market performers) in the longer term.
Goldman said it remained sceptical about Nera ASA (market performer) and Benefon (market underperformer.
